Name: Kedi's Tilesheets
Author: KeDili
Description:
[size=3]This is a mod for other mods to use it as a resource of tilesheets. I have converted my two furniture mods to map tilesheets so modders could use them in their maps too if they have wanted.

[b]For users:[/b] Just install this mod and unzip it in your Mods folder.

[b]For modders:[/b] Use the tilesheets in this mod just like they are vanilla tilesheets while mapping, just don’t include them while releasing/updating your mod (As this will cause bugs) and don’t forget to add this mod as a required dependency.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Adds tilesheets for other mods to depend on.
